gloss: within the deadline; before the expiration

definitions.gloss: within the deadline; within the time limit; before expiration
definitions.explanation: Within the specified time period or before a deadline passes. Used for deadlines, validity periods, and expiration dates.

examples.japanese: {期限内|きげんない}に{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit it within the deadline.

examples.japanese: {期限内|きげんない}であれば{返品|へんぴん}が{可能|かのう}です。
examples.english: Returns are possible within the time limit.

examples.japanese: {申請|しんせい}は{必|かなら}ず{期限内|きげんない}に{済|す}ませてください。{期限|きげん}を{過|す}ぎると{受|う}け{付|つ}けられません。
examples.english: Please be sure to complete the application within the deadline. It cannot be accepted after the deadline has passed.

notes:
Composed of {期限|きげん} (deadline, time limit) + {内|ない} (within). Functions as a noun or adverbial expression. Very commonly seen in business, administrative, and everyday contexts involving deadlines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {期限内|きげんない}に{提出|ていしゅつ}する — to submit within the deadline
- {期限内|きげんない}に{届|とど}ける — to deliver within the deadline
- {期限内|きげんない}に{支払|しはら}う — to pay within the deadline
- {期限内|きげんない}に{完了|かんりょう}する — to complete within the deadline

RELATED TERMS:
- {期限|きげん} — deadline, time limit
- {期限切|きげんぎ}れ — expired, past the deadline
- {有効期限|ゆうこうきげん} — expiration date; period of validity
- {締|し}め{切|き}り — deadline (for submissions)
- {期限外|きげんがい} — outside the deadline, overdue
